arithmetic: exact rational (fractions.Fraction); no floating point enters any verdict
determinism: states visited in the fixed order (prime tuple, box, parity, b); rows evaluated in that order; no randomness

global.unavailable_rule: a state exceeding a limit is recorded under its own UNAVAILABLE_* skip reason and never silently dropped

lattice_model_scan.note: pure sublattices of Z^3 (HNF); NOT claimed FIELD-I realizable

planar_base.note: reproduces the E2-P2 corpus (582 rows with source and target lattices nontrivial) and ADDS target-trivial rows (Lambda' = Z^2), which E2-P2 skipped under 'trivial_lattice'

three_d_S1.note: numerator exponents 2q_i or 2q_i+1 (the E2-P1 control has 2^5)

three_d_S2_rectangular_targets.exact_engine_budget: all predictor NOT_CONTAINED rows + every 10th predictor CONTAINED row (cap 400)
three_d_S2_rectangular_targets.filter: target lattice rectangular and nontrivial, q_i >= ord_{b'}(p_i) for all i
